age: All females used in experiments were 8–12 weeks of age.
cell_type: B cells specific for a model trophoblast antigen are strongly suppressed through CD22–LYN inhibitory signalling, which in turn implicates the sialylated glycans of the antigen as key suppressive determinants.
developmental_stage: Gestational dating for experimental mice was based on the presence of a copulation plug evident the morning after mating (designated as embryonic day 0.5 (E0.5)).
material_type: Human plasma was collected from healthy women after provision of informed consent (IRB numbers 20–32077 and 19–29812, UCSF).
sex: All females used in experiments were 8–12 weeks of age.
species: Mouse experiments were performed in accordance with institutional guidelines under protocols AN136579 and AN178689 approved by the Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee of the University of California San Francisco (UCSF).
strain: WT C57BL/6J and congenic CD45.1+ C57BL/6J (Ptprca) mice were purchased from The Jackson Laboratory.
tissue: Spleens were collected in RPMI 1640 (Gibco) plus 10% FBS buffer, crushed and passed through a 70-μM mesh strainer (Corning).
